quantities.score: prediction score on the held-out strings: 1 minus the mean Kullback-Leibler divergence from the exact predictor to the model, divided by that of the uniform guess on the same targets (0: uniform guess, 1: exact predictor)
quantities.auc: area under the ROC curve of the largest surprisal of a string, ungrammatical against grammatical held-out strings (0.5: chance, 1: exact predictor)
quantities.divergence_bits: the divergence itself, in bits per target; it is not compared across grammars and is not drawn
